caption: A storm rolls over a farm at night, and a bolt of lightning flashes from the clouds to the ground, lighting up the fields for an instant.

sa.check: A farm landscape at night under storm clouds.
A lightning bolt spans from the clouds to the ground.
The fields are lit briefly by the flash.
The bolt is jagged or branched.
The fields go dark again afterwards.

pc.expect: The bolt and the flash are brief: they appear, may flicker, and are gone; the landscape is lit only during the flash and returns to dark.
pc.fail: The bolt stands as a steady lit line for the whole clip; or the fields stay lit after the bolt has gone; or the sky brightens without a bolt and stays bright.

pc.expect: The flash lights the scene: fields, farm buildings and cloud undersides brighten during the bolt, lit from the bolt's direction.
pc.fail: The bolt is visible but the ground and clouds stay as dark as before; or the lit area is far from the bolt; or the fields are lit while no bolt is present.

pc.expect: The bolt is a jagged, branching bright line with a main channel.
pc.fail: The bolt is a perfectly straight beam; or a smooth wave; or a solid glowing tube that persists; or a shape with no connection between cloud and ground while the ground lights up.

pc.expect: Rain falls downward and wind-blown items move with the storm.
pc.fail: Rain rises or hangs still; or leaves blow upward steadily; or rain falls sideways while the trees stand still.
pc.precondition: Rain or wind-blown items are visible.

pc.expect: The farm's buildings, trees and fences are the same before and after the flash; the flash reveals what was there, it does not create or remove anything.
pc.fail: Buildings or trees appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the landscape changes layout after the flash; or a bolt passes through a building leaving it lit like a lamp.

pc.expect: The scene's colours are consistent: the flash whitens or blues the scene briefly and it returns to the same night colours.
pc.fail: The sky changes to daylight after the flash; or the fields change colour permanently; or clouds change shape abruptly between frames.

note: The caption's violation_types include gravity_direction; nothing about a bolt itself has a gravity direction, so it is covered only by the rain item P4, which is gated. Consider replacing gravity_direction with shape_identity on the data record.
